reasons.check_only: Evaluation-only mode does not run check-only cases.
reasons.extension: This file exercises an optional CEL extension library.
reasons.error_value: Error-valued variable bindings are not supported.
reasons.macro_configuration: The public Program API does not allow macro expansion to be disabled.
reasons.unknown: Unknown values and unknown propagation are not implemented.
reasons.locale: The public Program API does not expose locale selection.
